parameter_semantics: target_object selects blue for goal-relative conditioning; destination_goal selects the observed world point defining the per-replan translation frame; context_object selects buffered red. Positions are world metres and rotations are world-frame wxyz. Training binds blue, blue_goal and red.
output_semantics: Each slot is [goal-relative world dx,dy,dz in metres, world qw,qx,qy,qz, gripper]. The observed blue_goal position is fixed for one sampled chunk. Slots represent t-1 through t+14 and host execution uses slots 1..8. decode_action normalizes and canonicalizes the quaternion, adds the chunk goal translation, constructs a world TCP pose, invokes panda_kinematics.solve_ik from fresh qpos, and appends the native gripper scalar.

conversion_check.description: Adding the observed goal translation and normalizing the demonstrated unit quaternion recovers each command FK world TCP target. Quaternion unit/canonical projection is declared; the independent check compares position, rotation angle and gripper while allowing nonunique IK.

cut_relation: Every action of every assigned slice is supervised, preserving the full blue relocation responsibility plus 210-230 action predecessor overlaps and 230-240 action successor overlaps. Goal anchoring changes coordinates, not cuts or success semantics.
